purpose: Close the separate Path Validator source-read boundary after the descriptor-bound builder is audited; do not treat builder-only success as end-to-end safety.
observed_current_defects: validate_path_graph.validate reads graph.source_universe.scope without an independent expected-root argument.
It uses root/relative lstat then pathname sha256_file reopen. Unsafe relative paths and intermediate symlinks can leave the selected root.
It only revisits supplied inventory paths, rather than independently enumerating the current path set; new paths are not discovered.
bootstrap Reader resource contract does not currently hash Path builder/validator code. No retrospective migration assurance is justified.
proposed_bounded_changes: Require explicit caller source-root context for source verification; refuse missing/mismatched graph scope before reading any source paths. Update normal bootstrap invocation and directly affected synthetic tests.
Reject malformed, absolute, parent-traversal and noncanonical inventory paths before source IO. Preserve duplicates as errors, not last-wins dictionaries.

Use descriptor-bound no-follow source observation for current path/hash verification. If common low-level builder IO primitives are reused, state that code reuse is not independent algorithmic proof; keep independently asserted gold fixtures and separate graph/coverage checks.
Compare current complete path inventory to the submitted inventory and retain explicit failure on detected changes. Do not silently change, rehash or republish submitted graph artifacts.

Include Path builder/validator code in the Reader generation resource identity so explicit rebuild migration is signaled; preserve existing migration policy unless a separate F13 contract changes answer-time gating.

test_contract.sources: Only tiny temporary canonical roots and synthetic canaries outside each fixture root but inside the owned temporary directory.

dependencies: F01/F07 final audit freeze before editing shared bootstrap
Assigned file ownership and fresh source hashes before implementation
non_claims: No actual source verification without explicit root authority
No guaranteed answer-time freshness after validation
